runtime: Pure Go: standard image codecs via gomath/rasterimage. No Python, browser, native library or subprocess runtime, no test-time reference renderer.

scope.entrypoint: svg.Read(io.Reader, svg.Options), no new exported API
scope.uri_encoding: Strict standard base64, padding required when necessary, no folding/whitespace/percent encoding/MIME parameters; MIME verified against DecodeConfig.
scope.gif: Frame zero only. Reject partial logical canvas first frames; no animation/background/disposal composition.
scope.placement: x/y and width/height: intrinsic/auto, existing absolute units, percentages of current SVG/symbol viewport. Nine meet alignments, default xMidYMid meet, none. SVG transform and all ancestor/use/symbol transforms compose as affine matrices; local Y reflection preserves image row orientation.
scope.ownership: Identical URI strings share an immutable Bitmap only within one import. Each rendered instance has independent geometry, style and ID. No cross-import/global cache.
scope.styles: Existing CSS cascade, use shadow isolation, opacity/display/visibility. Vector paint properties do not apply to image pixels. Existing multiplicative group/object opacity and bitmap bilinear premultiplied sRGB sampling remain unchanged.
rejected: unknown image attributes and unknown CSS
scope.validation_timing: All image elements including unused defs are URI/attribute-whitelist validated and decoded. Geometry/transforms/styles/viewport clipping are checked when instantiated.
scope.resource_accounting: Headers checked before complete decode. Repeated image URI text counts toward URI/XML budgets; identical URI assets consume decode budgets only once. use expansion retains existing depth/node/CSS budgets. Stage limits do not promise a fixed process peak heap.
exclusions: No EXIF orientation/ICC processing beyond existing rasterimage semantics
No isolated offscreen group opacity compositing
No full SVG/browser CSS equivalence or Manim parity claim

fixture_origin.author: Synthetic deterministic assets generated locally for GoMath SVG tests; no third-party artwork.

embedded.png.generator: Pillow Image.new(RGBA); quadrant boundaries x=8,y=4; PNG default save

embedded.jpg.generator: embedded.png converted to RGB; Pillow JPEG quality=95, subsampling=0

embedded.gif.generator: Pillow: full-frame first palette frame red left four columns/green right four columns; second frame solid blue; duration=[100,100], loop=0, optimize=False

local_Manim_reference.finding: Shape dispatch is vector-oriented and does not dispatch embedded images. Independent Pillow/Cairo references are used for this added feature rather than claiming verified Manim parity.

decode.method: Pillow opens each original asset, seek(0), convert(RGBA), saves <filename>-decoded.png; Go tests compare the complete decoded bitmap in premultiplied RGBA.
decode.regenerate_python:
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
p=Path('tests/data/svg')
for name in ['embedded.png','embedded.jpg','embedded.gif']:
    with Image.open(p/name) as im:
        im.seek(0)
        im.convert('RGBA').save(p/(name+'-decoded.png'))

raster.coverage: PNG alpha quadrants, JPEG, animated GIF first frame, default meet and none, opacity, shear/rotation/reflection, defs/use reuse. A parent group supplies the reference use opacity; CSS opacity on use is independently tested with analytical pixels, not inferred from CairoSVG.
raster.regenerate_python:
from pathlib import Path
import cairosvg
p=Path('tests/data/svg')
s=(p/'embedded-images.svg').read_text().replace(' href=', ' xlink:href=')
cairosvg.svg2png(bytestring=s.encode(), write_to=str(p/'embedded-images.png'))
raster.reference_normalization: CairoSVG 2.7.x consumes xlink:href; generation normalizes unqualified href spelling only, preserving all geometry, data and styles.
raster.environment: Development reference commands use PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/lib. Neither required by Go tests.
raster.limitation: Cairo filters transparent image borders differently from the existing bitmap edge extension/coverage sampling. Full-frame tolerances cover these boundary differences. Exact analytical interior pixel tests separately assert orientation, multiplied opacity and transformed placement; independent complete decode comparisons prevent wrong/missing assets from being accepted by the raster tolerance.

coverage: all three codecs and full independent pixel decode
